ARCHITECTURE
Actual project structure
PROPULSION

4 × A2212 BLDC + 4 ESC + 4 × 1045 propellers. Same propulsion system is reused across air, land and water.

VECTORING

4 servo-driven motor pivots change thrust direction. Air = upward thrust; Land/Water = forward thrust.

CHASSIS

Carbon-fiber arms, lightweight aluminium/carbon frame, foam wheels for land mobility and buoyancy.

CONTROL

ESP32-S3 central controller with IMU, heading sensor, altitude/distance sensing, battery monitoring and telemetry.

BOARD BASIS
The placement is derived from the supplied custom-flight-controller schematic: ESP32-S3 at the center, sensor/I²C block adjacent, power/regulator domain separated, and ESC/vector-servo headers at the actuator edge.

SOURCE-DERIVED APPLICATIONS
Project Overview identifies disaster/flood rescue, coastal monitoring, hazardous inspection, industrial inspection and environmental monitoring. The supplied defence mapping additionally discusses all-terrain UGV, air-base surveillance and multi-medium coastal survey concepts.
